notes.title: Putin Destroys Alien: Definitive Edition (Free Update For Everyone)
notes.notes: [p]\[New Features][/p][list][*][p]A New Reality: Enhanced visual and gameplay improvements, making you fully immerse yourself in the experience of an egyptian god[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Transition Magic: Room transition reimagined[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The Obama Update: he will now transform into a sphere and aid you in combat[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Under The Influence: Added the effect of substances used[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]UI 2.0: Game UI overhaul, the menu is now alive[/p][/*][/list][p]\[Gameplay][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted difficulty: You are now spawning with maximum power, *KILL ALL ALIENS INVADER*[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Heavy Drinker: Grabbing the vodka will now give you even more spirit points[/p][/*][/list][p]\[Bugfix][/p][list][*][p]Fix a resolution issue where the player is unable to enter the game after startup[/p][/*][/list]
